functions.residue: RESIDUE REGPERM 26 r4->sl sl->r4 r1->r4 lr->ip ip->r1 r6->sb
functions.notes: Stopped after about 20 gate runs with no reduction below 26 bytes. Only the dedupe loop at 0x88-0x104 differs: the target keeps count in r4, i in sl, the found flag in r1, the id pointer in r2 and j in r3. Ours swaps count and i. A separate isNew flag with i declared at the top gave 30 bytes. Moving or removing the top int i shifts the earlier registers (69-75 bytes). Making count an int, a bool flag or an indexed inner loop gave no gain. colorsweep --apply (80 compiles) found nothing better than the current source.
